component.name: Pomodoro
component.summary: Focus in pomodoros and track your progress

description.p: A small, native Pomodoro timer: 25-minute focus, 5-minute break, four pomodoros to a session. Tag sessions by subject and follow your progress on a heatmap.

ul.li: Tags, a daily goal and streaks
Heatmap and statistics per day, month, year and all time
Nothing is lost: progress survives closing the app, crashes and power loss
Fully offline, with JSON export and import
